name: Computational Methods in Water Resources Engineering
description: Introduction to computational hydraulics, classification of differential equations, system of algebraic equations, numerical solution of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), numerical solution approaches of partial differential equations (PDEs) - finite difference method, finite volume method, weighted residuals method, finite element method, and mesh-free methods, solving problems on groundwater flow and transport, open channel flow, surface flooding, pressurized conduit flows.
